rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation/scope on admitted methods; i1040gi (2025) pp.106-108 Schedule1-A and Notice2025-69 SectionIII.B.2 give the employer-reported/premium amounts and the one-third, one-half and one-quarter conversions for supported pay statements. Both return zero for FLSA-ineligible employees and the same amount for supported methods. The reply either flattens the FLSA/method guards or uses the statement on method=other. The project refuses special-rule/other methods; no equivalence or admission of that excluded method is claimed. Full partial-input equivalence beyond the declared source cases is not inferred.
